payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the system significantly improved precision and reduced false positives compared to a mature production system, although specific numerical improvements are not provided.

claims.text: The system led to large improvements in precision over a mature and highly tuned constraint-based production information extraction system used at Bloomberg.
The full pipeline resulted in a reduction in false positives of more than a certain percentage, indicating substantial improvement in extraction accuracy.
The architecture resulted in substantial improvements over a mature and highly tuned constraint-based information extraction system for financial language text.
